# stackit_lb_ip_list (Data Source)

Load Balancer IP Lists resource schema.

~> This datasource is in beta and may be subject to breaking changes in the future. Use with caution. See our [guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/stackitcloud/stackit/latest/docs/guides/opting_into_beta_resources) for how to opt-in to use beta resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_lb_ip_list" "example" {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  region     = "eu01"
  name       = "example-ip-list"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Load Balancer IP List.
- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the Load Balancer is associated.

### Optional

- `region` (String) STACKIT region.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) The hash of the configured IP list.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID. It is structured as "`project_id`","region","`name`".
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined metadata as key-value pairs.
- `number_of_ips` (Number) The number of IP addresses in this IP list.
